article.headline: Pedro Neto nets brace as Chelsea end Everton's unbeaten run
article.description: Pedro Neto scored twice in the second half to guide Chelsea to a 2-0 win at Everton on Saturday in a Premier League match marred by a serious-looking head injury to Chelsea goalkeeper Emi Martínez.
